about: NHL stats (nhl.com/stats) via the NHL public JSON APIs (api.nhle.com/stats/rest and api-web.nhle.com). Covers league leaders, skater, goalie and team stat reports, player search, profiles and game logs, game details, standings, scores and schedules.

commands.summary: Top-10 skater leaders for points, goals or assists in a season (optionally rookies or defensemen only)

params.name: cayenneExp
params.description: Cayenne filter expression. Season is an 8-digit id like 20262027; gameType 2=regular season, 3=playoffs. You can append "and isRookie = 'Y'" or "and player.positionCode = 'D'".

commands.summary: Top-10 goalie leaders by goals-against average, save percentage or shutouts in a season

params.name: cayenneExp
params.description: Cayenne filter expression, e.g. season=20262027 and gameType=2 and gamesPlayed >= 2

commands.summary: Skater summary stats report (GP, G, A, PTS, +/-, PPG, TOI and more), with filters, sorting and paging

params.name: cayenneExp
params.description: Cayenne filter. Season range: gameTypeId=2 and seasonId<=20262027 and seasonId>=20262027. Prefix 'franchiseId=5 and ' to filter by franchise (ids from list-franchises). Add 'and skaterFullName likeIgn

params.name: sort
params.description: JSON array of sort keys, e.g. [{"property":"goals","direction":"DESC"},{"property":"playerId","direction":"ASC"}]. Common properties: points, goals, assists, gamesPlayed, plusMinus, shots, timeOnIcePe

params.name: isAggregate
params.description: true sums multiple seasons or games into one row per player (all-time or date-range totals)

params.name: isGame
params.description: true returns game-level rows filtered by gameDate

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Rows per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: Skater time-on-ice report (total, EV, PP, SH, OT TOI and shifts), with filters, sorting and paging

params.name: cayenneExp
params.description: Cayenne filter, e.g. franchiseId=5 and gameTypeId=2 and seasonId<=20252026 and seasonId>=20252026

params.name: sort
params.description: JSON sort array. Properties include timeOnIce, timeOnIcePerGame, ppTimeOnIce, shTimeOnIce, shifts.

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Rows per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: Goalie summary stats report (W, L, GAA, SV%, SO), with filters, sorting and paging

params.name: cayenneExp
params.description: Cayenne filter, e.g. gameTypeId=2 and seasonId<=20262027 and seasonId>=20262027 (prefix franchiseId=N and ... to filter by franchise)

params.name: sort
params.description: JSON sort array. Properties include wins, savePct, goalsAgainstAverage, shutouts, gamesPlayed.

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Rows per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: Team summary stats (W, L, OTL, PTS, GF, GA, PP%, PK%) by season, or all-time totals with isAggregate=true

params.name: cayenneExp
params.description: Cayenne filter. One season: gameTypeId=2 and seasonId<=20262027 and seasonId>=20262027. All-time: seasonId>=19171918 with isAggregate=true.

params.name: sort
params.description: JSON sort array. Use franchiseId instead of teamId as the tiebreaker when isAggregate=true.

params.name: isAggregate
params.description: true gives one row per franchise summed over the season range

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Rows per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: Find players by (partial) name to get their player id

params.name: name
params.description: Name or part of a name (case-insensitive substring match)

commands.summary: Player profile header: name, team, position, number, age, height, weight and headshot

params.name: playerId
params.description: NHL player id (from search-players or stats rows)

commands.summary: Player stat lines: current season, career and per-season totals with team ranks
Player biography: birth date and place, draft details, shoots/catches
Player game-by-game log for a season and game type (regular season or playoffs)

params.name: season
params.description: 8-digit season id, e.g. 20262027 (playerStatsSeasons in the response lists the valid seasons)

commands.summary: Game overview: teams, score, venue, scoring summary by period, three stars

params.name: gameId
params.description: 10-digit game id, e.g. 2026020119 (from scores, schedule or a game log)

commands.summary: Game box score: per-player stats (G, A, +/-, TOI, SOG, hits) for forwards, defense and goalies
Full play-by-play event list for a game (shots, goals, penalties, faceoffs, with coordinates)
Game side info: season series, officials, coaches, scratches, linescore by period, video ids
NHL.com recap articles for a game (headline, summary, slug)
League standings as of a date (division, conference and wild-card ordering, records, points)
Seasons that have standings, with their date ranges and rules (ties, wild card, etc.)
All games and scores for a date (state, teams, score, goals)
League schedule for the week starting on a date (games per day, teams, start times, broadcasts)
Schedule calendar window for a date: start/end dates, previous/next week, and the list of teams
All NHL seasons, newest first, with ids, dates, number of games and rules
The season and game type the stats site currently defaults to
All NHL franchises with ids (for franchiseId filters) and first/last seasons
Countries (and their states/provinces) usable as player nationality or birthplace filters
NHL entry draft years and number of rounds
Stats glossary: abbreviation, full name and definition of every stat
